focus: Angle 8: ACP and other integration seams

label: vibe-acp accepts only -h, -v and --setup; model, agent profile, working directory and approvals are all negotiated over the protocol, so an ACP client configures a session rather than a command line.
ACP advertises load_session, prompt capabilities with embedded context and images but no audio, and session capabilities for close, list and fork.

ACP routes approvals to the client through request_permission with options derived from required permissions and path scopes, so a headless client can answer per call instead of pre-authorizing the run.
ACP exposes three session config options: session mode (agent profile), model, and thinking (reasoning effort), which is the reasoning-effort control print mode lacks.
ACP streams usage updates with input, output, total and cached-read tokens plus session cost in USD.
ACP supports turn-level cancel, and the waiting prompt request settles with a cancelled stop reason, so cancellation is a protocol outcome rather than a killed process.
ACP has no export.json, so the print-mode output-dir export with version, config, usage, cost, stop reason and outcome has no ACP counterpart and a client would have to persist the stream itself.

Print mode fits the fan-out better: one process per lineage, a closed exit-code taxonomy and a durable outcome file map onto how fanout-run spawns, waits and audits, while ACP would need a long-lived client, a session multiplexer, a permission policy and its own outcome persistence.

ACP wins on control, not on fit: per-call approvals, mid-run cancel, session fork and reasoning-effort selection are unavailable in print mode, so the recommendation is print mode for dispatch and ACP as an optional second mode.

direction: Replacing the print-mode dispatch with ACP in this phase
reason: It needs a protocol client and outcome persistence first, and would lose the export contract the audit path already reads.

direction: Treating vibe-acp as a thin wrapper over vibe -p
reason: It is a separate entrypoint with its own capability negotiation and no flag surface.

label: A cli-mistral-vibe dispatch should use print mode with output-dir export as its primary surface and treat ACP as an opt-in control channel, because only print mode yields the exit code and export the audit path consumes.
